tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Orkero's developer docs and API reference. Answers the best matching pages and requests, each with the name to pass to read_doc or describe_endpoint.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Read one page of Orkero's docs as Markdown. Pass its name, e.g. "quickstart-booking", "keys", "errors", "webhooks" or "reference/booking". Pass "index" for the list of every page.

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: Every request the Orkero API has: method, path, what it does, the key scope it needs, and whether it is live or early access (planned, not callable yet).

tools.name: describe_endpoint
tools.description: Everything about one request: its query fields, body fields, an example in curl, TypeScript and Python, the answer and its errors. Pass its id from list_endpoints, or its path such as "/v1/booking/times".

tools.name: call_api
tools.description: Make one request to the Orkero API with the developer's test key (set as the Authorization header in their MCP client settings). Test keys reach a test practice only: bookings and feedback are checked in full but nothing is kept, booked or sent. Live keys are refused here.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "call_api" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
